data.for_supervisor: VERDICT: Implementation complete. Created 3 files and modified 2 existing files. The flashcards API client (flashcards-api.ts) follows the exact pattern from ai-api.ts with proper TypeScript types. The subtitle-tooltip.tsx now has a subtle save button that appears in the vocabulary dialog footer after AI explanation, shows saving/saved states, and sends word, explanation, sourceSentence, and videoId to the API. The flashcards page at /flashcards fetches and displays all flashcards as cards with word (bold), truncated explanation, italic source sentence, video link, and a delete button. All code compiles cleanly (vite build succeeds) and only pre-existing TS errors remain in top-bar.tsx. Ready for testing.
